content:
Apple is rumored to have more new iPhones launching in 2027 than ever before, and a new post from leaker Digital Chat Station corroborates that. Here’s what he says is coming.

Here’s what to expect from 2027’s new iPhone models

This fall, Apple will launch a smaller than usual flagship iPhone lineup. We’re expecting only three models: iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, and iPhone Ultra.

But by pushing the base iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2 into early 2027, Apple will soon have its biggest year of new iPhones ever.

Leaker Digital Chat Station just shared the full list of 2027 iPhone models in a new Weibo post. Here’s the translated text:

Apple’s 2027 Product Line:

iPhone Air 2 6.55″ 1.5K 120Hz LTPO OLED ✓


iPhone 18 6.3″ 1.5K 120Hz LTPO OLED ✓
iPhone 18e 6.12″ 1.5K 60Hz LTPS OLED ✓

iPhone 19 Pro Series Mold Testing Complete ✓


iPhone Ultra 2 Wide Foldable Screen Mold Testing ✓

Rumors indicate the first three models will launch early in 2027, likely no later than March. Then the latter three—featuring a 20th anniversary design for Pro and Pro Max models—will debut in September.

The new post provides a status update on the fall 2027 models, but it also highlights screen size and display technology for the early 2027 lineup.

iPhone Air 2 and iPhone 18 are said to retain the same screen sizes and tech as their predecessors, which was already expected. But iPhone 18e will reportedly do the same, and most notably that means no ProMotion support.

While the 6.12-inch screen size and 60Hz display are unchanged from iPhone 17e, Apple could still switch to a Dynamic Island from the current notch design. However, due to the memory crisis, it wouldn’t be surprising to see minimal changes for iPhone 18e to prevent big price increases.
